notes.blurb: Farmhouse timber under deep thatch. Dark posts and pale boards, the floor lifted clear of the ground, the roof by far the biggest thing about the building.
notes.construction: boarded walls between a heavy exposed frame, openings wide rather than tall and screened rather than glazed, dark timber against pale board
notes.ground: a raised floor on posts clear of the wet, with a veranda along the long side at floor level
notes.roofs: irimoya or hip, shallow (1,2) then steep (2,1) at the ridge, eaves deep and upturned, one or two tiers
notes.signature: the engawa -- the boarded veranda running the length of the building under the overhanging eave
